note: Hand-curated semantic layer. NOT part of the Aksenov et al. methodology; see docs/AKSENOV_METHOD_NOTES.md Part 3. Every node and edge carries a `source` that must resolve to a real file, and for Lean sources to a real declaration in formal_graph.json; `python3 -m tools.research_context validate` enforces this. Seeded only from results the repository documents explicitly -- where the documentation does not support a claim, the claim is absent and the omission is recorded in `known_gaps`.

nodes.title: Type-II divergent orbit (the target)
nodes.summary: The object the repository exists to exclude: an accelerated Collatz orbit that diverges. Everything below is either a reduction of this, a conditional handle on it, or a route to it that has been closed.

nodes.title: Curry hypothesis (ReciprocalSummable)
nodes.summary: Summability of the reciprocals along the orbit. Everything in the Curry sector is conditional on this and must be labelled as such -- it is an assumed input, not a theorem of the repository.

nodes.title: Curry normalization to the zero corridor
nodes.summary: Conditionally on Curry, a hypothetical Type-II orbit can be restarted at the last global drift maximum so that R_0 = 0 and R_N < 0 for N >= 1, hence S_N <= floor(N*alpha) and the deficit is non-negative. This is the normalization every later Curry-sector argument assumes.

nodes.title: Drift tends to minus infinity under Curry
nodes.summary: R_N -> -infinity for every reciprocally-summable accelerated orbit. Labelled CURRY + ELEMENTARY CONSEQUENCE in the foundation document: not stated by Curry, but a short rigorous consequence via the Eliahou-Rozier identity.

nodes.title: Deficit divergence is equivalent to drift divergence
nodes.summary: R'_k = -Delta_k - {k*alpha} with the fractional correction bounded in (-1,0], so R'_k -> -infinity is exactly Delta_k -> infinity. This is the coordinate identity that lets the Curry sector be studied in deficit coordinates at all.

nodes.title: Deficit recursion (pure algebra)
nodes.summary: Delta_{k+1} = Delta_k + b_{k+1} - d_k, where b is the Beatty gap and d the valuation digit. Its Lean proof is `unfold deficit; push_cast; ring`. This is the canonical example of a recurrence that looks dynamical and carries no information -- see the coordinate-change gate.

nodes.title: Deficit increases by at most one per step
nodes.summary: Delta_{k+1} <= Delta_k + 1 whenever every digit is at least 1, so Delta -> infinity requires infinitely many steps with Beatty gap 2 and digit 1, each buying one unit. Corollary of the recursion and the Beatty gap; not an obstruction.

nodes.title: FiniteValuationWord (the central datatype)
nodes.summary: The valuation-word abstraction on which most of the library is built; by a wide margin the most depended-upon EOC declaration (425 reverse dependencies inside EOC).

nodes.title: Bounded prefix realizers = positive-integer realizability
nodes.summary: sup_N r_N < infinity  <=>  the infinite valuation word has a positive-integer realizer  <=>  r_N is eventually constant. Unconditional, and independent of the Curry sector. Consequence: qualitative unbounded-realizer growth is NOT an easier target than positive-integer realizability, and must not be pursued as if it were.

nodes.title: Least prefix realizer stabilizes
nodes.summary: Bounded least-prefix-realizers are eventually constant. For an actual positive seed m_0 this means r_N = m_0 once 2^{S_N+1} > m_0 -- an extremely rigid signature, but not a mechanism for forbidding stabilization.

nodes.title: Dynamic deficit feedback is a reparameterization
nodes.summary: The loop Delta_N -> m_N -> d_N = v_2(3m_N+1) -> Delta_{N+1} is the Bernstein-Lagarias 2-adic conjugacy in deficit coordinates; every arrow is a definition or an already-proved identity. The state-size ceiling d_N <= log2(3m_N+1) is strictly WEAKER than the zero-corridor ceiling d_N <= Delta_N + b for every seed m_0 >= 2, so a large state constrains the next valuation less than the corridor already does.

nodes.title: The surviving sector: zero-corridor, unboundedly many defects, diverging deficit
nodes.summary: Population C in the frontier document: the sector that remains open after the controlled sectors are removed. The moving-anchor obstruction is itself the open problem here, not a tool for attacking it.

nodes.title: Chain A arithmetic bottleneck: PowerOfTwoDangerousWindowSparsity
nodes.summary: The documented open target: prove PowerOfTwoDangerousWindowSparsity for all sufficiently large even j, every shift t in range, and some logarithmic K <= A*log2(j)+1; the lambda = 1 case is the essential core. Separately open and needed by the exceptional-set chain: lower shells sigma < floor(j*alpha) and barrier offsets U > 0. The document states explicitly that it is NOT proved, NOT known to follow from any equidistribution theorem, and NOT claimed equivalent to any named conjecture.

nodes.title: Tao-style machinery is gated on an unproved hypothesis
nodes.summary: The repository's Chain A Fourier / dangerous-window machinery is a CONDITIONAL result gated on TaoMixingHypothesis, an unproved external interface. It does not currently reach the realizability frontier, and re-running it there will not change that without progress on the hypothesis itself.

nodes.title: Pell / continued-fraction drift approximants
nodes.summary: Listed among routes not to repeat. The documented reason is precise and narrow: NO REPOSITORY RESULT CONNECTS THESE TO REALIZABILITY; the route would have to be developed from scratch with a stated realizability connection, not assumed. The repository does NOT document any stronger closure (e.g. a proved decoupling of real approximation from 2-adic behaviour) -- see known_gaps.

nodes.title: Discriminator criterion for any proposed invariant
nodes.summary: Before spending effort on a candidate invariant I(W), require an answer to whether I distinguishes finite prefixes coming from a fixed positive-integer orbit from those that do not. Arbitrary complexity statistics with no realizability-connection criterion must pass this bar first.

nodes.title: Coordinate-change / tautology gate
nodes.summary: Screening heuristic distilled from two completed audits: if a proposed quantity is a deterministic function of the digit word or orbit state, its recurrence will be provable by `unfold; ring` and carries no new restriction. Not a general proof of equivalence.
